headline: Costco (COST) Is Running A Florida Distribution Center Fully Off The Grid
summary: Costco Wholesale has begun operating its Port St. Lucie, Florida distribution center fully off the power grid. The facility now runs on an on-site solar and battery energy system in partnership with Trinity Energy. This move aligns the site with Costco's broader net zero and sustainability objectives. Costco Wholesale, ticker NasdaqGS:COST, is adding a new dimension to its investment story with this off grid distribution center in Florida. The stock closed at $951.58, with a return of 11.4%...

headline: Breaking Free from the Grid, Costco Teams with Trinity Energy to Pioneer True Commercial Energy Independence
summary: SNOHOMISH, Wash., July 28, 2026--Trinity Energy (Trinity), a leading provider of integrated operating systems for sustainable energy solutions has taken Costco Wholesale off grid with the launch of independent, on-site energy system at Costco’s distribution center in Port St. Lucie, Florida.
